profile.name: HDF5实验数据文件后端
profile.description: 用于实验室测量数据存储、组织与读取的HDF5数据文件组件。它适合将实验结果按层级分组保存，记录节点属性与元数据，并存放定长、可扩展或变长数组数据，常用于实验数据归档与后处理。
profile.description_en: A software component for storing, organizing, and reading laboratory measurement data in HDF5 files. It is used to save experimental results in hierarchical groups, record node attributes and metadata, and store fixed-size, extendable, or variable-length array data for data archiving and post-processing.
